draftNote: 3 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane), Cuban Noobster (midlane→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: Two 0-4 fights at their Fangtooth — both taken with the offlane alive and absent — plus the film flagging three of us with no armor into a four-fifths-physical comp decided this one.
coaching.team: The winning pieces were there: Drongo went 10/6 with six kills on Zinx, the support matchup was won all game, and the 14.5 teamfight was a clean 4-0 answer. But the file flags the same absence four times — the offlane alive and never joining at 13.5, 20.5, 21.9 and 26.1, all losses at or near their Fangtooth — and the film flags three of us with no armor against a comp led by Khaimera's 28k physical. The ledger closed 12 objective takes to 23, and their final run — Genesis Core at 25, Primal at 27, Orb Prime at 28 — is priced death by death in the file.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The second 0-4 at their Fangtooth at 20.5 tipped it — Fangtooth and an inner tower fell inside a minute — and the 26.1 0-3 at their Primal pit cashed out as Primal Fangtooth, the inhibitor and Orb Prime all at once.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 won the support matchup wire to wire — 17865 healing and 11 assists on Phase — but the late falls at 19.1, 20.6, 22 and 26.1 each preceded a lost Fangtooth, tower or the final collapse. On a team where three ran no armor, the link support was always the first squish down; the fix was the team's item screen as much as his positioning.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324's Drongo won the read and the lane — 10 kills, six of them on Zinx, with first blood at 3.4 — but the 20.6, 21.9 and 26.1 deaths came in the short-handed Fangtooth fights the file prices at inner towers and the endgame. A kiting carry needs the missing bodies before entering those; the third core item (Tainted Rounds, the missing meta core) never arrived either.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster's Belica drew the 'theirs all game' read into a Gadget who finished 6/1, and it showed — 3/5 with two solo catches at 5.3 and 27 and two completed items in 28 minutes. Pinned lanes are the film's excuse for missing fights; the catches on the walk are the part to drill.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim had the team's safest line — 1/1/5 with 31,248 mitigated — and its most repeated flag: alive and never joining the losses at 13.5, 20.5, 21.9 and 26.1. Shinbi's wolfpack ult exists for exactly those grouped fights; the team fought four deciding ones without her.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' jungle read was 'theirs all game' into Wukong and the price tags landed on him: the 12.5 catch preceded their Fangtooth and the 15.4 catch preceded three towers in forty seconds. Yin hunts isolated duels, but with no armor into a four-physical comp, every one of those walks was the enemy's fight, not his.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Zinx. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range

ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage
